purpose: Evidence for the October reply-quality investigation. Not a production policy or a claim of improved writing.
requestedScope: Available October 2026 public replies and their immediate parent posts.

collection.publicationLedger: agent_bridge.js publication-attempts, state confirmed_published, limit 500. 479 records returned before filtering by actual October publication IDs and reply action.
collection.monthMatching: Published ID timestamps, then live timeline timestamps and inReplyTo parent IDs. Attempt creation dates are not used as proof of publication dates.
collection.liveReader: Installed approved XActions pin, normal read-only search and getTweetsAndReplies. No upstream update.
collection.timelineStop: Stopped after three own-account timeline rows before 2026-10-01. Older parent posts do not trigger this stop.
collection.detailLookup: 102 individual parent lookups. 99 succeeded. The loop stopped on a rate limit. The normal profile timeline then supplied the bulk source/reply pairs without a rate-limit error.
collection.extendedText: Audit-only fetch inspection retained note_tweet.note_tweet_results.result.text where present. Production parser was not modified.

classification.purpose: Reading aid. The two provisional_model columns are unvalidated model suggestions, not editorial verdicts or send gates.
classification.manualAssessment: The report and replay-case index contain the parent analyst assessment of selected cases. No claim that every model label received manual review.

limits: Public timeline retrieval cannot prove coverage of deleted, hidden, unavailable or omitted posts.
Immediate parent text does not supply every image, video, quoted post, linked document or surrounding turn.
An extended-text payload is not by itself proof that the legacy payload was truncated.
The ten replies outside the matched publication ledger have no established human/agent origin.
No performance association proves follower growth, causation, or owner acceptance.
The current parser and current source code do not prove the exact runtime inputs used for each historical publication.
sensitiveData: Public post text and public identifiers only. No cookies, request headers, credentials, private profile fields or database copy.
